subject: Kinda dissapointing
author: ZombieTron
body:
I was really excited about Burnout CRASH! The Kinect gameplay video that inspired me to pretend to play looked so much fun!

But, what I have seen since seems really dry and uninspiring in comparison.

There seems to be lots of missed opportunities to me. Things I have noticed are that the traffic all seems to be driving at the same speed... slow! Why not have the busses and works vehicles drive a bit slower and the ambulance with the flashing lights and sports cars should be zooming through the junctions.

Also, the tidal wave bit at the end isn't as much fun as it should be... but maybe that will be more intense the more percentage you get? He only got 80% so there is room for improvement on that.

Or maybe sound is vital!

I hope it gets released quickly so we can play it for ourselves before too many other bad vdeos come out to put us off!
